title: Sparse Inversions
prompt:
**Problem.** Each query: n then n values up to 1e9 (duplicates
allowed). Print the number of inversions.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

Compression + Fenwick; the merge-sort W counts equal pairs.

tests.name: with duplicates
tests.hint: Strict pairs a[i] > a[j]: (2,1),(2,1b),(2b,1b) — 3; the equal pair 2=2 is NOT counted.

tests.name: load: 200000 values to 1e9
tests.hint: Compression + Fenwick handles sparse values; merge-sort W overcounts equal pairs.
